title: New SignDrop Exploit Can Abuse Windows Defender to Bypass Security Protections
summary: SignDrop is a Windows zero-day that abuses CLFS security protections to let local attackers gain SYSTEM privileges and bypass defenses. The researcher Chaotic Eclipse, also known as INFINITE NIGHTMARE, MSNightmare, Nightmare-Eclipse, and MSNightmare, published a proof-of-concept for a new Windows local privilege escalation zero-day, naming it SignD...
advisory: Urgent: Patch edge devices and review perimeter telemetry immediately.
